articles.title: U.S. regulator warns prediction markets against cutting corners in event contracts
articles.snippet: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission again issued an advisory that signals firms have been straying into cookie-cutter self-certification.

articles.title: Europe's high regulatory bar could spark new crypto industry M&A wave
articles.snippet: As MiCA beds in and the U.K. finalizes its crypto framework, stringent regulation could spur mergers, acquisitions and closer ties with banks.

articles.title: Shiba Inu surges 36% as South Korean traders fuel mystery rally
articles.snippet: The rally has no announcement behind it, other dog tokens haven't matched it, and Korean venues are carrying the volume.

articles.title: Crypto exchange BitMart to shut down after nine years, BMX token crashes 58%
articles.snippet: Users have a month to close trades and six months to withdraw funds, and the exchange gave no specific reason for the closure.

articles.title: Russia’s largest bank Sberbank plans crypto trading infrastructure by December
articles.snippet: New regulations for crypto trading, custody, and settlement in Russia take effect Sept. 1, with requirements for licensed intermediaries applying from July 2027.
